mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the GDP growth rate (GDPC1) over a 6-month horizon signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the subsequent 20 trading days, as corporate earnings expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative GDP growth signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals an acceleration in economic activity, which historically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investor sentiment improves.
failure_condition: INDPRO rises but S&P 500 20d returns are negative in > 50% of triggered periods, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.0% triggers a shift in investor expectations toward lower future discount rates, which historically produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as bond yields compress.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls below 4.0% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS falls below 4.0% but S&P 500 20d returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises above 4.5% but S&P 500 20d returns are positive in > 60% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the housing starts index (HOUST) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening residential construction activity, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as housing sector earnings expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: HOUST declines but S&P 500 20d returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
